trophies.short: Launder a quarter of a million dollars of marked bills through your contacts. Robberies feed it; patience finishes it.
trophies.guide: Marked bills come from robberies (vaults, operations and trucks especially) and they are worth little until a contact launders them, at a cut, into clean money. This trophy tracks the gross amount you put through that process: 250,000 dollars of marked bills laundered. The economy of it is simple: rob profitably, launder promptly, and never sit on a pile of marked cash when a contact is nearby, because the counter only moves when the laundering happens. Rates and caps vary between contacts in the sources, so if one contact's throughput feels slow, rotate. The tracker counter here counts laundered dollars, and a stage 6 routine of operations and vaults will feed it steadily while also paying for your garages and shopping totals.

steps.t: Earn marked bills from vaults, operations and truck robberies
Take marked bills to a laundering contact rather than sitting on them
Launder in regular batches; the counter moves on laundering, not on earning
Rotate contacts if one has a daily cap or a poor rate
Keep the robbery routine going through stage 6 until the total builds
Reach 250,000 dollars laundered for the trophy

tips.t: Vault takes are the richest marked-bill source; pair this grind with Maximum Withdrawal

disputes.topic: Does the counter track bills handed over, or clean money received?

a.t: It tracks the marked bills you hand over, before the cut

b.t: It tracks the clean money you receive after the cut

disputes.verdict: Plan for the stricter reading: launder until the in-game stat itself reads 250,000, not your estimate of it.

missable.t: Robberies and contacts stay available all game

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.short: Spend 100,000 dollars in shops. Clothes, weapons, vehicles services and food all count toward the one total.
trophies.guide: The friendliest grind on the list: spend money in shops until the total reaches 100,000 dollars. Everything bought across the game's shops feeds the one counter, so the trophy mostly earns itself during a normal platinum run, where weapons, armour, vehicle work and property upkeep keep the till ringing. If you reach the endgame short of the line, the efficient top-up is useful spending, not waste: stock ammunition, armour and vehicle repairs, buy the clothes you actually like, and let the counter cross the line on things you needed. The tracker counts dollars spent; check it before any deliberate shopping trip, because many players discover they crossed the line hours ago without noticing.

steps.t: Check the spending counter in the stats menu; the run may have done this already
Spend naturally during the story: weapons, armour, vehicle work, food
Avoid hoarding cash mid-game; the laundering and spending totals both reward flow
If short in the endgame, top up with useful stock: ammunition, armour, repairs
Reach 100,000 dollars spent across shops for the trophy

tips.t: Property purchases are handled by their own trophy; this one is shop spending

disputes.topic: Do vehicle purchases count as shop spending?

a.t: Yes, dealership spending counts toward the total

b.t: Only walk-in shops count; dealerships are separate

disputes.verdict: Spend across everything and watch the stat itself; it settles the argument in your own game.

missable.t: Shops stay open and money keeps flowing all game

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.short: Buy all eight garage properties. They unlock across the map as you play; the only gate is having the cash.
trophies.guide: Eight garage properties are spread across Leonida, each buyable when you find it and have the asking price, and owning all eight earns the trophy. Garages are worth buying early and often even without the trophy, because they give your vehicle collection somewhere to live and make the discovery and registration trophies easier to manage. The purchase routine is simple: as your roaming opens new districts, check the property markers, buy what you can afford, and let robbery income refill the wallet between purchases. The tracker counts owned garages. If cash is the bottleneck, a stage 6 loop of operations and vaults is the fastest honest income, and it feeds the laundering counter while it pays for your real estate.

steps.t: Check property markers whenever a new district opens
Buy each garage as you can afford it rather than saving for all eight
Use garages to store the vehicles your other counters care about
Fund the later garages with operation and vault income in stage 6
Purchase the eighth garage for the trophy

disputes.topic: Are all eight garages available from the start?

a.t: Garages unlock by district as the map opens

b.t: All eight can be bought as soon as you have the cash

disputes.verdict: Either way the method is the same: buy on sight whenever the marker and the money are both there.

missable.t: Properties stay on the market until bought

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.short: Register ten vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. Registration is a deliberate act in the app, not just driving the vehicle once.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app is the game's vehicle registration system, and this trophy wants ten vehicles registered to it. Registration is not the same as discovery: sitting in a new car feeds Whip It Good, but On the Spot needs the extra step of actually registering the vehicle through the app or its prompt while you are with the vehicle. The cheap way to earn this is to make it a reflex early: every time a story mission or a stranger hands you a new vehicle, register it on the spot (the title is the instruction) before driving off. Ten registrations accumulate quickly that way. If you reach the endgame short, any ten vehicles you own or are sitting in can be registered in one short session.

steps.t: Open the Scooter Bros app and find the registration option
Register the vehicle you are in; registration is a deliberate step, not automatic
Make it a reflex: register every story-gifted vehicle before driving off
Check the registered count in the app, not the discovery stat
Register the tenth vehicle for the trophy

tips.t: Discovery and registration are different counters; do not let a big discovery number fool you

disputes.topic: Does registering require owning the vehicle?

a.t: No, a vehicle you are using can be registered on the spot

b.t: Only owned or garaged vehicles can be registered

disputes.verdict: Try registering whatever you are driving first; if the app refuses, register from your garages instead. Both paths reach ten quickly.

missable.t: Vehicles and the app stay available all game
